accident_report:
Vehicle initialization:
On a dry, flat, single-direction roadway with three lanes (numbered from right to left as lane 1 to lane 3), the road segment includes a moderate աջ curve with a rigid guardrail installed along the left boundary of lane 3. Visibility is good. Vehicle V1 is traveling in lane 2 at 85 km/h, maintaining a steady गति and intending to follow the curve without lane changes. Vehicle V2 is ahead of V1 in the same lane 2 at a distance of approximately 12 meters, traveling at 60 km/h due to cautious driving through the curve, resulting in a significant speed difference between V1 and V2. Vehicle V3 is in lane 3, slightly behind V1 by about 8 meters, traveling at 90 km/h and intending to overtake traffic by continuing along the leftmost lane. Vehicle V4 is in lane 1, slightly ahead of V1 by about 5 meters, moving at 70 km/h and preparing to change lanes toward lane 2 to position for the upcoming curve.

Scenario development:
As all vehicles enter the curved section, V1 continues at 85 km/h while following V2 at an unsafe close distance of 12 meters. Due to the curve geometry, V1’s forward visibility is partially limited, reducing its perception of V2’s lower speed. Meanwhile, V4 initiates an illegal lane change from lane 1 into lane 2 without sufficient gap assessment, cutting into the narrow space between V1 and V2. This forces V1 to react immediately. Because of the already short following distance and the large speed difference with V2, V1 performs sudden braking, reducing speed rapidly from 85 km/h to 50 km/h.

V3, traveling faster at 90 km/h in lane 3, observes V1’s abrupt deceleration and attempts to maintain its overtaking trajectory. However, due to the curve and proximity to the rigid guardrail, V3 cannot safely change lanes to avoid the developing situation. At the same time, V4, having cut into lane 2, is now directly ahead of V1 and also begins braking to match V2’s slower speed, further compressing the spacing.

The combined effects of the curve limiting sight distance, the illegal cut-in by V4, and the pre-existing close following distance cause V1’s braking to propagate backward as a sudden deceleration event. V3, with a higher speed and limited lateral escape due to the guardrail, attempts emergency braking but cannot reduce speed sufficiently within the available दूरी.

Result:
V3 collides with the rear-left side of V1 in lane 3’s boundary area, constituting the first collision. The impact occurs near the rigid guardrail as V3 fails to decelerate in time due to the compounded effects of high speed, limited სივრცე, and the chain reaction initiated by V4’s illegal lane change.
